title: Buddhist Era Calendar
intro: The Buddhist Era calendar in this provider presents Gregorian civil dates with Buddhist year numbering.
structure: Month names, lengths, January year start and leap days are identical to the Gregorian rules: years divisible by four are leap years except centuries not divisible by 400.
model: The year displayed is the Gregorian year plus 543; subtract 543 to recover the Gregorian year. All month/day navigation follows the same underlying civil day.
example: 1 January 2026 CE corresponds to 1 January 2569 B.E.; February 2024 CE is February 2567 B.E. and has 29 days.
history: Buddhist Era numbering commemorates a traditional chronology associated with the Buddha. Thailand uses Buddhist Era year numbers for civil dates.
limits: This is not a universal historical Buddhist chronology. It does not reproduce Thailand's former April New Year or all regional religious conventions.
